name: MFLOUR
recent: Malayan Flour Mills 在2026年11月16日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利按年增长。公司近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项董事及大股东权益变动的申报。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利按年增长。
公司于2026年9月至10月期间多次进行股份回购。
执行董事 Azhari Arshad 于2026年11月17日增持16,000股普通股。
risks: 执行副主席兼董事经理 Teh Wee Chye 在封闭期内表示有意进行交易。
公司有一项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人的公告。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为798,656,000令吉，按年微降0.2%，按季增长7.7%；净利为42,933,000令吉，按年增长53.0%，按季增长1.1%；净利率为5.4%，低于上一季度的5.7%。

recent_en: Malayan Flour Mills announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026, with net profit rising year-on-year. The company has been continuously conducting share buybacks and has made several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit increasing year-on-year.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks during September and October 2026.
Executive Director Azhari Arshad acquired 16,000 ordinary shares on 17 November 2026.
risks_en: Executive Deputy Chairman cum Managing Director Teh Wee Chye indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
The company has an announcement on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR798,656,000, down 0.2% year-on-year but up 7.7% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR42,933,000, up 53.0% year-on-year and 1.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.4%, lower than 5.7% in the previous quarter.
